hero.description: Transform ideas into functional, visual, and strategic digital products. Our approach combines innovation, user experience, and high-impact design to create applications that stand out and achieve real results. We build each project with you, understanding your needs from the very first moment.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Get to know us
about.description: We are specialists in application design and development with a strategic, experience-oriented approach. We are passionate about creating products that solve real problems and deliver fluid, modern, and functional digital experiences.
about.pageDescription: At WEBALO, we are a development laboratory focused on building digital solutions that drive businesses toward innovation. We were born with the vision of bringing modern technologies to companies that need to grow, digitize processes, or scale products without losing the essence of their operation. We are characterized by an analytical mindset, technical creativity, and the ability to solve problems quickly and precisely.

why.title: Why Choose WEBALO?
why.subtitle: What We Offer
why.point1: We take care of every detail, from the first sketches to the micro-interactions that make your product feel fluid and modern.
why.point2: We apply agile methodologies that ensure fast, organized processes with clear deliverables in each phase of the project.
why.point3: We design more than an app—we build complete experiences centered on the user and aligned with your strategic objectives.
why.point4: We drive your project's growth, creating solid foundations and a clear path to evolve your product long-term.

workflow.title: HOW WE WORK
workflow.step1_title: We explore and understand your idea
workflow.step1_desc: Our approach is based on listening first to propose later.
workflow.step2_desc: We adjust every element to achieve coherence in design and function.
workflow.step3_title: We bring design to life with identity and detail
workflow.step3_desc: We take care of every detail so your product looks solid, modern, and ready to impress.
workflow.step4_desc: Our process is designed to reduce risks and increase the impact of the final product. We close with a clear delivery ready to move to production.

plans.title: Our Plans
plans.subtitle: Discover the plan that fits your needs and professional goals

quick_audit.name: Quick Audit
quick_audit.description: Basic review of a website or application, detection of visible errors, user experience analysis, and report with up to 5 improvement recommendations.

brand_launch_kit.name: Brand Launch Kit
brand_launch_kit.description: Initial digital identity setup: color palette, recommended typography, favicon, basic icons, and quick usage guide for web projects.

flow_builder.name: Flow Builder
flow_builder.description: Navigation flow design for a website or application of up to 3 screens, navigation map, and recommendations to optimize user experience.

smart_interface.name: Smart Interface
smart_interface.description: High-fidelity interface design for up to 6 screens, reusable components, basic visual guide, and one round of adjustments.

digital_experience_pro.name: Digital Experience Pro
digital_experience_pro.description: Quick user research, main flow optimization, redesign of up to 7 screens, interactive prototype, and two rounds of revisions before delivery.

stack_starter.name: Stack Starter
stack_starter.description: 1-hour session to define idea, objectives, audience; basic function schema; recommendations on design or technology viability.

wirewave.name: WireWave
wirewave.description: 2 sketches for 2 screens + simple navigation flow + one round of adjustments.

proto_max.name: Proto Max
proto_max.description: Set of icons, illustrations, graphics ready to use in the app, exported for developers.

protopulse.name: ProtoPulse
protopulse.description: Wireframe + clickable prototype + feedback + one correction.

iconic_stack.name: Iconic Stack
iconic_stack.description: Design of button animations, transitions between screens, micro-interactions for visual feedback.

ui_orbit.name: UI Orbit
ui_orbit.description: Visual design for 8 screens, colors, buttons, typography; light style guide.

pixel_forge.name: Pixel Forge
pixel_forge.description: Visual design + navigable prototype + simple transitions + two rounds of feedback.

app_reboot.name: App Reboot
app_reboot.description: Basic user research (personas, use cases), wireframes, visual design for 15 screens, style guide (colors, typography, iconography).

motion_spark.name: Motion Spark
motion_spark.description: Current app audit, redesign of key screens, optimized flow, new prototype.

investor_edge.name: Investor Edge
investor_edge.description: Visual prototype very close to the final product + usability testing with users (3-5 people) + recommendations report.

launchpad.name: LaunchPad
launchpad.description: Complete screen design, interactive prototype, presentation mockups (for pitch), style and visual guides for investor slides.

custom.title: CUSTOM
custom.subtitle: None of our plans exactly fit your needs?
custom.description: At WEBALO, we understand that every project is unique. If the plans we offer don't cover 100% of your objectives, or if you want to combine several services into a custom package, we can create a specialized service adapted to your idea and your team.
custom.point1: Content and functionalities designed according to your specific needs.
custom.point2: Flexibility in timelines, deliverables, and number of screens or prototypes.
custom.point3: Resource optimization to get the maximum value from your investment.
custom.contactText: Contact us and we will gladly prepare a proposal tailored to your project.

offer.title: Our Offer
offer.tab1_desc1: This solution is designed to help you clearly define the direction of your digital project. We analyze your current situation and transform your ideas into concrete actions that allow you to move forward with confidence. Here we evaluate your real opportunities and focus your efforts on what truly generates results.
offer.tab1_desc2: Our goal is to give you a stable foundation where you can build without uncertainty. We guide you step by step so you understand every decision, every flow, and every proposed improvement. We want you to have control, but with expert support that avoids errors and accelerates the process.
offer.tab1_desc3: The result is clear and measurable progress, where your project grows with intention and coherence. All while you acquire new skills and better understand how your own product works.
